lines: In hundred-and-eight cakra two-hundreds rising would be; in order thus this cakra six-times doubled when.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśatastūdayo bhavet krameṇetthamidaṃ cakraṃ ṣaṭkṛtvo dviguṇaṃ yadā
